question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A long shot
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Little chance of success'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'A long shot'** is** 'Little chance of success'.**
 
• **A long shot:** an attempt or guess that has only the slightest chance of succeeding or being accurate. (एक प्रयास या अनुमान जिसके सफल होने या सटीक होने की थोड़ी सी भी संभावना है)
 
 
• *Example: It's **a long shot,** but well worth trying.** *

 
 
 

​​**Correct Answer:__** *Little chance of success.*
